description: A dense canopy of silver-eyelet trees that cast long, confusing shadows. A huge metal sign reads: 'This forest makes you forget things but makes you remember the things you want to forget.' A dense memory fog pools around your laces.

forest_wall.description: Thick, tangled brambles of faded laces and memory vines.

forest_floor.description: Damp dirt covered in silver pine needles.

exit_east.description: Back east to the Scream Collector structure.

exit_west.description: A pathway heading west toward the scent of salt and sea.

conditions.failMessage: You are too confused and blind to find the way west! You must save your friends first.

forgotten_clearing.description: The center of the forest where the fog is thickest. Willy and Freddista stand here look dazed.

dialogue.text: "Willy, who is this shoe next to me?" you ask. Willy screams: "I forgot how to walk!" Freddista collapses: "I... I forgot how to breathe!" You panic: "She stared at me, I've gone blind!" (If you have Thermal Sight, your advanced infrared vision pierces the fog, allowing you to clearly see their outlines!) (Hint: Scream to save Freddista and Willy!)

Fred screams, filling the forest with starchy hope. Freddista gasps and starts breathing again! Willy re-learns how to walk! Willy yells: "Fred, she doesn't kill shoes!" Your memories rush back and your sight returns! The path west is now open!
The silver-eyelet trees hum peacefully now. Willy sighs: "Let's get out of this creepy forest before I forget how to eat waffles again."
